title: Tiny, cute croissant
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <!-- shadow/plate hint -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="82" rx="30" ry="6" fill="#5a3a1a" opacity="0.6"/>
  
  <!-- croissant body - curved crescent shape -->
  <path d="M20 55 Q18 40 30 32 Q40 26 50 30 Q60 26 70 32 Q82 40 80 55 Q78 68 65 72 Q55 75 50 70 Q45 75 35 72 Q22 68 20 55 Z" fill="#e8a83e"/>
  
  <!-- lighter center/top highlight -->
  <path d="M30 38 Q38 30 50 34 Q62 30 70 38 Q72 48 65 55 Q55 60 50 55 Q45 60 35 55 Q28 48 30 38 Z" fill="#f5c96a"/>
  
  <!-- flaky layers - curved lines on the crescent -->
  <path d="M30 45 Q40 40 50 43 Q60 40 70 45" fill="none" stroke="#d08a28" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M28 52 Q38 48 50 50 Q62 48 72 52" fill="none" stroke="#d08a28" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M32 60 Q40 56 50 58 Q60 56 68 60" fill="none" stroke="#d08a28" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- segments/lobes on the croissant -->
  <path d="M38 32 Q36 40 38 50" fill="none" stroke="#d08a28" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M50 30 Q48 40 50 52" fill="none" stroke="#d08a28" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M62 32 Q64 40 62 50" fill="none" stroke="#d08a28" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- tips of the croissant - slightly darker -->
  <path d="M20 55 Q18 60 22 65 Q26 62 25 55 Z" fill="#d08a28"/>
  <path d="M80 55 Q82 60 78 65 Q74 62 75 55 Z" fill="#d08a28"/>
  
  <!-- cute little face on the croissant -->
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="43" cy="46" r="3" fill="#3a1a00"/>
  <circle cx="57" cy="46" r="3" fill="#3a1a00"/>
  <!-- eye sparkle -->
  <circle cx="44" cy="45" r="1.2" fill="#fff"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="45" r="1.2" fill="#fff"/>
  
  <!-- little smile -->
  <path d="M46 52 Q50 56 54 52" fill="none" stroke="#3a1a00" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- blush cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="52" rx="3.5" ry="2.5" fill="#e87070" opacity="0.7"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="52" rx="3.5" ry="2.5" fill="#e87070" opacity="0.7"/>
  
  <!-- tiny sparkle dots around -->
  <circle cx="15" cy="35" r="1.5" fill="#f5e070" opacity="0.8"/>
  <circle cx="85" cy="40" r="1.5" fill="#f5e070" opacity="0.8"/>
  <circle cx="75" cy="25" r="1.2" fill="#f5e070" opacity="0.6"/>
</svg>
